# Turing Mirror (图灵镜)

> Touching the setsuna, reaching the future.

Turing Mirror (Chinese: 图灵镜, Traditional: 圖靈鏡, Japanese: チューリングミラー) — official website. All products below are free. The site is available in Simplified Chinese (https://www.turingmirror.com/), Traditional Chinese, English (https://www.turingmirror.com/en/) and Japanese.

## Products

### RVC Fabric

Consolidates RVC's command-line tools and web scripts into a streamlined native desktop application. Real-time voice conversion, offline processing, vocal separation, dataset slicing, pitch extraction, model training, index building, and model merging are unified in a 9 MB installer that automatically configures the matching runtime for your GPU on first launch.

- Platform: Windows · Desktop
- Windows 10 / 11 · Automatically adapts to NVIDIA (incl. RTX 50 series), AMD and Intel GPUs
- Page: https://www.turingmirror.com/en/products/rvc-fabric/ (简体中文: https://www.turingmirror.com/products/rvc-fabric/)
- Links: Download for Windows: https://cdn.turingmirror.com/d/rvc-fabric-setup; GitHub: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/RVC-Fabric; CNB mirror (China): https://cnb.cool/Turing-Mirror/RVC-Fabric-Releases
- Real-time conversion: Low-latency inference, seamless voice switching mid-session, and one-click bypass to your original voice. End-to-end latency under 80 ms, with ASIO channel selection and independent monitoring routing
- DSP effect chain: Built-in noise gate, compressor and 5-band parametric EQ, with presets and fine-tuning.
- Voices & presets: A grid voice library with .index bindings; save, import and share parameter presets.
- Community voice store: Official and third-party sources, with multi-threaded, resumable downloads.
- Audio toolbox: Separate vocals from accompaniment, turn text into speech in any voice, and train your own voice in one click. Guided visual workflow covering audio slicing, RMVPE pitch extraction, model training, and index export, with checkpoint resume support
- Automatic acceleration: Detects NVIDIA CUDA or AMD / Intel DirectML and downloads the matching runtime for you.

### MoeText / 喵言喵

Built on Android's accessibility service, MoeText rewrites what you type in QQ and Discord using rules you define: swap words, add sentence endings and kaomoji, and switch between styles like catgirl or classical Chinese in one tap.

- Platform: Android
- Requires Android 6.0 or later · Allow installs from unknown sources when installing
- Page: https://www.turingmirror.com/en/products/moetext/ (简体中文: https://www.turingmirror.com/products/moetext/)
- Links: Download APK: https://cdn.turingmirror.com/d/moetype; GitHub: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/MoeText
- Style packs: Four built-in styles (catgirl, classical Chinese, emoji riddles and oracle) switch in one tap. Import and export your own as JSON.
- Rule-chain engine: Combine quick swaps, custom replacements, sentence endings, fixed suffixes and random kaomoji.
- Two modes: Rewrite after a pause or as you type, and send messages the way you always do.
- Stays out of your way: Continuous editing, cursor mapping and write-back retries keep the suffix at the end as you keep typing.
- Material 3 design: Follows system dark mode, with a live preview built in.
- No data collection: Network access is only used to check for updates. Nothing is collected or uploaded.

### Mirror-Test / 测试镜

Interactive quizzes that run right in your browser. From anime and GalGames to girls' bands, answer a few questions and find out which type you are. Results are just for fun and are not a real personality assessment.

- Platform: Web
- Nothing to install. Works in mobile and desktop browsers.
- Page: https://www.turingmirror.com/en/products/mirror-test/ (简体中文: https://www.turingmirror.com/products/mirror-test/)
- Links: Start a quiz: https://test.turingmirror.com/; GitHub: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/Mirror-Test
- Summer 2026 anime personality test: Find the summer 2026 anime that matches you best.
- GalGame destined-route test: Which destined route would you end up on?
- Band-TI girls' band character test: 20 questions drawn from a pool of 100, covering 67 characters, 8 series and 14 bands.

### Turing Mirror UI / 图灵镜 UI / TRM UI

TRM UI provides consistent components, colors and interaction rules for Turing Mirror desktop apps. The gallery demonstrates the components and explains interaction, writing and motion. Projects use a verified package version and can retain their existing language and theme settings.

- Platform: Shared components for developers
- The gallery runs in a browser. Running the Tauri desktop shell requires Rust.
- Page: https://www.turingmirror.com/en/products/trm-ui/ (简体中文: https://www.turingmirror.com/products/trm-ui/)
- Links: View project: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/TRM-UI; Read integration guide: https://github.com/Turing-Mirror/TRM-UI/blob/8689c8c2833e147d0665c3560e3b5057aba26a50/docs/components-v1.md
- Shared components: Buttons, forms, menus, tooltips and dialogs are maintained in one package. Products receive improvements by updating their dependency.
- Interactive design guidance: The gallery covers interaction, writing, typography, color and motion, and records replaced designs and the reasons for each change.
- Continuous interaction: Segmented controls support dragging. Filtered lists retain existing items, and panels resize continuously as content changes.
- Eight languages and theme settings: Common interface text is available in eight languages. Products can connect their translations and use shared color variables or their own theme.
